scenarios.label: Public app for many Zendesk customers
scenarios.when_this_applies: You offer the agent to customers outside your company and want it published on the Zendesk Marketplace.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; profile fields and listing assets from c6, c9

waiting.estimate: 1-3 weeks for new submissions; 1-2 weeks for updates

scenarios.approval: Zendesk reviews Marketplace submissions and profiles, and checks content against its Branding guidelines. Whether a listing is required before outside customers can connect is unconfirmed.

prerequisites.title: Marketplace profile details
prerequisites.detail: Prepare a short value proposition, a long description under 300 words, and a Zendesk point of contact for escalation. The profile is optional, but it is reviewed with a first submission.

prerequisites.title: Listing assets
prerequisites.detail: Prepare at least three screenshots. Short videos or demos are recommended.

steps.title: Confirm Composio managed Zendesk OAuth
steps.detail: Check that composio_managed_auth_schemes for the zendesk toolkit includes OAUTH2. Use the managed app for prototypes.
steps.done_when: Managed status confirmed and a prototype connection works.

steps.title: Register your own Zendesk OAuth client
steps.detail: Create the OAuth client in your Zendesk account and note the client ID and secret. The dossier has no Zendesk-specific registration details, so follow Zendesk's developer docs.
steps.done_when: You hold a client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config with your app
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API using your client ID and secret, and check the redirect URI matches the one in the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: A connection through your own app succeeds.

steps.title: Draft profile text and listing checklist
steps.detail: Write the short and long descriptions, a screenshot list and a demo script. Check the content against Zendesk's Branding guidelines.
steps.done_when: Drafts are ready for your review.

steps.title: Record demo and submit the app
steps.detail: Capture screenshots, give accurate compliance answers, agree to the Terms and Conditions, and submit.

steps.title: Wait for Zendesk review
steps.detail: New submissions take about 1-3 weeks. Later updates take about 1-2 weeks each.
steps.done_when: The app is approved and published.

traps.title: Marketplace requirement is unconfirmed
traps.detail: The dossier does not say whether outside customers can connect without a Marketplace listing. Confirm this with Zendesk before you plan the launch date.

traps.title: Every update is reviewed again
traps.detail: Changes to a published app, including content and assets, go through a separate Submit Update review of 1-2 weeks.

traps.title: Managed app limits
traps.detail: The managed app shares quota with all Composio users and enforces 15-minute trigger polling. Users also see Composio's name on the consent screen.

traps.title: Press wording rules
traps.detail: Zendesk must not be named as announcing your integration. Use 'working with' instead of 'partnership' unless approved.

blockers.symptom: Submission is held up or rejected over branding
blockers.what_it_means: Zendesk checks submitted content against its Branding guidelines.
blockers.what_to_do: Fix the content flagged and resubmit as an update.
blockers.agent_can_help: Review your assets and text against the Branding guidelines before you submit.
